Polk County, the Defending the Florida Dream Tour is coming your way! Join us THIS FRIDAY, April 24, at Reececliff Family Diner in Lakeland with special guest Sheriff Grady Judd. 

Doors open at 10:00 AM, we'll see you there!

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/lakeland

Had an amazing time in Sarasota County at CoastLife Church! 

Thank you, Pastor Jason for your warm welcome and leadership.

It was an honor to share my faith and vision for the future of Florida with such a great community!

The California Dream has become a California Nightmare because of crazy, radical, progressive policies that promise the world but never delivered.

We are fighting to preserve and protect the Florida Dream.

As your next Governor, I will protect the Florida way of life while preparing it for its future.
